newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch March consumer spending rises 2.1 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Dutch March consumer spending rises 2.1 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Dutch consumer spending rose 2.1 percent in volume terms in March compared with March 1996, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.
DUTCH CONSUMER SPENDING March 97 Feb 97 Jan 97
DUTCH CONSUMER SPENDING Q1 97 Q4 96 Q3 96
NOTE -- The CBS noted that 1996 had been a leap year and that this had a dampening effect on the year-on-year comparison between the first quarter of 1997 and the first quarter of 1996.
On the other hand, Easter had fallen during the first quarter of 1997 -- as opposed to the second quarter in 1996 -- and that this had had a positive impact on consumer spending.
